set_all_fields: set all fields in a protobuf TestAllTypes message to unique test values
set_all_extensions: set all extension fields in a protobuf TestAllExtensions message to unique test values
expect_all_fields_set: assert that all fields in a protobuf message have the expected test values
set_packed_fields: set all packed repeated fields in a protobuf TestPackedTypes message to test values
nonstandard_integer: create a custom Integral subclass for testing protobuf handling of non-standard integer types
